newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P downgrades Email to A-minus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P downgrades Email to A-minus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday that it downgraded its corporate credit and commercial paper ratings of household appliance goods group Email Ltd to A-minus/A2 from A/A1.
The ratings agency said it had removed the ratings from Creditwatch, where they were placed on June 30, and had assigned a negative rating outlook.
"The downgrade reflects Email's continuing greater use of debt leverage to fund asset growth than was factored into Email's "A/A1 ratings," it said.
"The combination of higher leverage, low domestic growth, and strong competition in core segments has resulted in Email's prudential measures being subpar from the rating."

S&P said the company had strong-to-leading market positions in its core businesses and the new rating gave the company some latitude to pursue its strategy of developing core operations at home and overseas through acquisitions and strategic alliances.
